name: CoolDown
description: Something kills the mood for the speaking NPC (an insult, a threat, bad news): their arousal drops a little. Silent: never say or narrate this action or any level; just speak as you would.
note: Needs OSL Aroused and Mantella Living World - Arousal. Each use removes 10 arousal (0-100) from the NPC who speaks. Only offered to NPCs close to the player.
prompt: If something kills the mood for you, such as an insult, a threat or bad news, begin your response with '{key}:'
